args.title: agg_daily_rides volume collapse caused by stale raw.trips_raw feed
args.description_markdown:
**Causal chain:** `raw.trips_raw` → `stg_trips` → `fct_trips` → `agg_daily_rides`.

The source `raw.trips_raw` is 26.03 hours stale against a 6-hour SLA (20.03 hours over) and is confirmed to have no upstreams. `stg_trips` fell from 1,281,900 to 3,120 rows (-99.76%); `fct_trips` has 3,120 rows versus its 50,000 floor; `agg_daily_rides` fell from 182 to 4 rows (-97.8%) and failed its expected 25..400 assertion.

Blast radius includes 16 downstream entities. Highest observed usage includes Exec Daily Ops (3,100 weekly views), `fct_trips` (2,121 queries/30d), and Rides by Hour (1,840 weekly views).

Human action required: restore the trips source ingestion, verify `pickup_ts`, rerun the source-to-mart pipeline, and re-evaluate assertions. This triage did not modify warehouse data.

Sixteen downstream entities are affected, led by Exec Daily Ops (3,100 weekly views) and `fct_trips` (2,121 monthly queries). A critical incident was raised, assets tagged, owners notified, and the post-mortem saved under `run_34f92ac9c7234f76`. Data Platform must restore ingestion, verify `pickup_ts` and watermark state, rerun raw-to-mart pipelines, and validate assertions; no data was repaired by this triage.
